import collections
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

PRIVATE = Path('/tmp/style-m3-a9-20261017')
BASE = 'c2afa6b0cd089c3c9408fe7e20f623d0562c32b7'
REPORT = Path('docs/review/M3-A9-2026-10-17.json')

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], text=True)

def events(name):
    result = []
    for line in (PRIVATE / (name + '.log')).read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
            if isinstance(value, dict) and 'Action' in value:
                result.append(value)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return result

def counts(es):
    return dict(collections.Counter(e['Action'] for e in es if e.get('Test') and e['Action'] in ('pass', 'fail', 'skip')))

required = ['test-root-release', 'test-agenthooks-final', 'vet-root-release', 'vet-agenthooks-final',
            'race-state-release', 'race-engine-runtime-release', 'race-app-release', 'collectors-final-2',
            'build-release', 'build-linux-release', 'build-windows-release', 'refresh-cli-release',
            'smoke-release', 'migration-release', 'replace-release', 'git-release', 'update-release',
            'frozen-release', 'project-release', 'process-final', 'environment-release']
runs = {}
for path in sorted(PRIVATE.glob('*.json')):
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or 'command' not in value or 'exit_code' not in value:
        continue
    log = path.with_suffix('.log')
    value.update(metadata_sha256=sha(path.read_bytes()), private_log=str(log), log_sha256=sha(log.read_bytes()))
    es = events(path.stem)
    if es:
        value['test_events'] = counts(es)
        value['tested_packages'] = [e['Package'] for e in es if e['Action'] == 'pass' and not e.get('Test')]
        value['skipped_tests'] = [e['Package'] + ':' + e['Test'] for e in es if e['Action'] == 'skip' and e.get('Test')]
    runs[path.stem] = value
for name in required:
    assert name in runs and runs[name]['exit_code'] == 0, name

changed = sorted(set(git('diff', '--name-only', BASE).splitlines()) |
                 set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()))
source = {p: sha(Path(p).read_bytes()) for p in changed if not p.startswith('docs/')}
new_tests = {p: re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(', Path(p).read_text(), re.M) for p in changed if p.endswith('/refresh_test.go') or p.endswith('/refresh_fault_test.go')}
new_keys = {('github.com/inxups/style-cli/' + str(Path(p).parent), name) for p, names in new_tests.items() for name in names}
root_events = events('test-root-release')
passes = [e for e in root_events if e.get('Test') and e['Action'] == 'pass' and (e['Package'], e['Test'].split('/')[0]) in new_keys]
leaves = [e for e in passes if not any(v['Package'] == e['Package'] and v['Test'].startswith(e['Test'] + '/') for v in passes)]
functions = [e for e in passes if '/' not in e['Test']]
assert len(functions) == 29 and len(leaves) == 85 and len(passes) == 98
assert counts(root_events) == {'pass': 2935, 'skip': 2}
assert counts(events('test-agenthooks-final')) == {'pass': 510, 'skip': 23}
assert not any('(cached)' in e.get('Output', '') for e in root_events + events('test-agenthooks-final'))

cli = json.loads((PRIVATE / 'cli-results-release.json').read_text())
assert cli['status'] == 'passed' and len(cli['cases']) == 50 and cli['real_harness'] is False
assert all(v['samples'] == 50 and v['p95_ms'] < 50 for v in cli['performance'])
assert cli['binary_sha256'] == sha((PRIVATE / 'style-release').read_bytes())
assert cli['old_binary_sha256'] == '31ed26797e2849a160ede978e43c108371fa31fc948039e8976a26e8509e0866'
gates = {}
for name, expected in [('migration', 16), ('replace', 12), ('git', 17), ('update', 24), ('frozen', 30), ('project', 18)]:
    path = PRIVATE / (name + '-results-release.json')
    result = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert len(result['cases']) == expected
    gates[name] = {'cases': expected, 'report_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes()), 'result': result}
assert 'Ran 68 tests' in (PRIVATE / 'collectors-final-2.log').read_text()
assert (PRIVATE / 'collectors-final-2.log').read_text().rstrip().endswith('OK')
assert (PRIVATE / 'smoke-release.log').read_text().count('ok   ') == 40

groups = [
    ('A9-01', ['core/spec/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshValidation', 'TestRefreshDefaultsFromAndSingleFile'], 'source validation, inheritance, single-file and native/combination boundaries'),
    ('A9-02', ['core/plan/refresh_test.go', 'internal/app/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshSystemRequiresDynamicPrompt', 'TestRefreshOtherTargetsNeverBecomeStatic', 'TestM3A9FiveRouteLifecycleAndSurface'], 'dynamic placement and clock-only Claude surface on all five routes'),
    ('A9-03', ['core/state/refresh_test.go', 'core/engine/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshRollingCadenceAndClock', 'TestRefreshUnmatchedSourcesAndCompactFalse', 'TestRefreshCapRollbackAndBlockPrecedence'], 'rolling intervals, first emission, no backlog and non-consuming unmatched/empty/capped cases'),
    ('A9-04', ['core/state/refresh_test.go', 'internal/runtime/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshNativeReplayLateUnknownAndFallback', 'TestRefreshRejectsCorruptionSymlinksAndOverflow', 'TestRefreshRuntimeClockOnlyAndNativeWire'], 'native ID replay/late/unknown/fallback, overflow and no skill/model-switch increment'),
    ('A9-05', ['core/state/refresh_test.go', 'core/engine/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshLifecycleAndScopeIsolation', 'TestRefreshUnmatchedSourcesAndCompactFalse'], 'startup/clear/compact/resume/fork, child and separate roots'),
    ('A9-06', ['core/compile/refresh_test.go', 'core/engine/refresh_test.go', 'internal/app/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshCompiledFormatAndPolicyEquivalence', 'TestRefreshRenderedBodiesWarnAndMultiplePoints', 'TestM3A9FiveRouteLifecycleAndSurface'], 'rendered identity, warn channels, multiple points, full-policy folding and retained package after uninstall'),
    ('A9-07', ['core/state/refresh_test.go', 'core/state/refresh_fault_test.go', 'internal/runtime/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshSynchronizedProcessesAndCrash', 'TestRefreshLockDeadlineIdentityAndSnapshot', 'TestRefreshCleanupPreservesActiveLock', 'TestRefreshCleanupFirstEnableAndLegacyCandidates', 'TestRefreshBusyUsesExistingFailPolicy'], 'six real worker processes at a barrier: same ID once / six IDs six ordered claims, crash unlock, 20ms/cancellation and cold cleanup'),
    ('A9-08', ['core/state/refresh_fault_test.go', 'core/engine/refresh_test.go', 'internal/app/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshWriteAndRollbackFailuresPreservePriorClaims', 'TestRefreshStaleReleaseDoesNotUndoOtherInvocation', 'TestRefreshCapRollbackAndBlockPrecedence', 'TestM3A9PolicyChangesApprovalAndTransactionRollback'], 'actual read-only-directory I/O failures, retryable release, prior claims, stale nonce protection and applied-build cancellation rollback'),
    ('A9-09', ['core/compile/refresh_test.go', 'core/state/refresh_test.go', 'scripts/check_m3_refresh.py'], ['TestRefreshCompiledFormatAndPolicyEquivalence', 'TestRefreshBodyMigrationIntervalsAndRollback'], 'strict formats, old ordinary seed and interval reuse; actual A6 runner/management refusal without file changes'),
    ('A9-10', ['core/tokens/refresh_test.go', 'internal/runtime/refresh_test.go', 'internal/app/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshBudgetsUseFullEmission', 'TestRefreshRuntimeClockOnlyAndNativeWire', 'TestM3A9ExplainSnapshotMatchesRuntimeReadOnly'], 'full budgets, unchanged stats schema/readers, optional safe planning/provenance/trace and output accounting'),
    ('A9-11', ['core/state/refresh_fault_test.go', 'core/state/refresh_test.go', 'internal/app/refresh_test.go'], ['TestRefreshSnapshotCombinedFileAndByteLimits', 'TestRefreshStrictRequiredStateFields', 'TestRefreshLockDeadlineIdentityAndSnapshot', 'TestRefreshRejectsCorruptionSymlinksAndOverflow', 'TestM3A9ExplainSnapshotMatchesRuntimeReadOnly'], 'read-only guarded capture, existing snapshot drift tests, strict/bounded state, no raw ID/body metadata and exact runtime wire'),
    ('A9-12', ['internal/app/refresh_test.go', 'scripts/check_m3_refresh.py'], ['TestM3A9FiveRouteLifecycleAndSurface', 'TestM3A9PolicyChangesApprovalAndTransactionRollback'], 'five-route lifecycle and effect/approval rollback, actual CLI compatibility, fresh modules/vet/race/process and latency')
]
known = {name for names in new_tests.values() for name in names}
for _, files, names, _ in groups:
    assert all(Path(p).exists() for p in files) and all(n in known for n in names)

causes = {
    'refresh-state': 'fixture initially assumed harness-scoped ordinary legacy claims, and permission fixture preparation attempted an ordinary update while a guard was active; process lock creation also failed',
    'refresh-state-2': 'unused test-loop variable after correcting fixture',
    'refresh-state-3': 'synchronized macOS O_CREATE open returned ENOENT',
    'refresh-process-repeat': 'reproduced synchronized macOS O_CREATE open ENOENT',
    'refresh-process-unsandboxed': 'same synchronized failure outside sandbox; fixed production creation to O_EXCL then open winner',
    'refresh-engine': 'skill.explicit fixture omitted required match selector',
    'refresh-engine-2': 'assertion assumed output record precedes the dedup record',
    'refresh-runtime': 'fixture incorrectly required empty stderr despite normal agenthooks INFO logs',
    'refresh-app': 'test used a nonexistent Runtime field on ExplainRequest',
    'refresh-app-2': 'unused test import',
    'full-root': 'same unused app test import',
    'cli-gate': 'codex-plugin fixture omitted PLUGIN_ROOT required by the generated launcher',
    'refresh-changes': 'test referenced a nonexistent project declaration effects field',
    'refresh-changes-2': 'test referenced a nonexistent binding effects field; corrected to the declaration digest',
    'refresh-changes-3': 'test tried Install to replace an already installed package; corrected to explicit Update',
    'refresh-final-targeted': 'new mismatch test supplied a null harness map invalid under the existing index schema',
    'refresh-targeted-2': 'five-route test reused a deliberately forbidden detector after frozen verification; fixture now restores definitions/source fetcher',
    'test-root-final': 'compiled before the frozen fixture detector restore; same known fixture failure',
    'race-final': 'compiled before the frozen fixture detector restore; state/engine/runtime packages passed, app fixture failed',
    'collectors-final': 'sandbox refused local HTTP listener and pseudo-terminals; identical offline suite passed with local fixture access'
}
failed = []
for name, value in runs.items():
    if value['exit_code']:
        assert name in causes, 'unexplained run: ' + name
        failed.append({'run': name, 'reason': causes[name], 'exit_code': value['exit_code'], 'log_sha256': value['log_sha256']})

report = {
    'format': 1, 'task': 'M3-T40', 'test': 'M3-A9', 'date': '2026-10-17', 'status': 'passed',
    'source_base': BASE, 'production_baseline': '22551eed12b27a5db2a2fc4d1a26da5f67538c63',
    'meaning': 'offline implementation acceptance, real OS processes and genuine old CLI; no real harness delivery',
    'authorization': {'user_reply': 'ok', 'approved_contract': 'docs/review/M3-D4-REFRESH-2026-10-17.md', 'approval_commit': BASE},
    'environment': json.loads((PRIVATE / 'environment-release.log').read_text()),
    'scope': {'routes': [v['route'] for v in cli['performance']], 'runtime_platforms_implemented': ['darwin', 'linux'], 'native_platform_executed': 'darwin/arm64', 'cross_build_only': ['linux/amd64', 'windows/amd64'], 'unsupported_refresh_platforms': 'all others; Windows pending D11/T70'},
    'implementation': {'clock': 'independent per root/harness/session/agent, hashed native IDs, prompt-only advancement, fallback disclosed', 'cursor': 'full SHA256 strategy identity for generation/optional epoch/rule/rendered model body/N, nonce-protected rollback', 'guard': 'permanent session inode, OS-released flock, 20ms/deadline/cancellation, cold cleanup locks even first-enable candidates then quarantines before close/unlink', 'state_limits': {'bytes_per_namespace': 4194304, 'receipts_plus_cursors': 40000, 'snapshot_bytes_all_state': 16777216, 'snapshot_files_all_state': 10000}, 'compiled': 'format 2 only final positive runtime entries; otherwise format 1; provenance optional and digest-bound', 'agenthooks': 'protocol, event tables, config rendering, owner and trust unchanged; STYLE selects extra Claude clock inputs', 'compatibility': 'existing session/scope/seen, lock 1/2/3, project declaration/binding formats, stats fields/results and prior golden files unchanged'},
    'new_acceptance': {'passing_functions': len(functions), 'leaf_cases': len(leaves), 'pass_events_including_groups': len(passes), 'fail': 0, 'helper': {'function': 'TestRefreshProcessHelper', 'top_level_non_worker_mode': 'skip, separately reported', 'actual_execution': 'spawned by synchronized-process/crash parent tests; real exit codes and output/q/receipt counts asserted', 'busy_retry': 'test coordinator retries only explicit busy; production remains capped at 20ms'}, 'test_functions': new_tests},
    'regression': {'root': counts(root_events), 'agenthooks': counts(events('test-agenthooks-final')), 'combined_pass_events': 3445, 'existing_opt_in_skips': 24, 'additional_helper_top_level_skip': 1, 'cached_test_results': False, 'vets': 'both modules passed', 'race': {name: counts(events(name)) for name in ['race-state-release', 'race-engine-runtime-release', 'race-app-release']}, 'collectors': 68, 'smoke': 40, 'old_cli_gates': gates},
    'refresh_built_cli': {'report_sha256': sha((PRIVATE / 'cli-results-release.json').read_bytes()), **cli, 'old_binary_source': '22551eed12b27a5db2a2fc4d1a26da5f67538c63', 'old_management_boundary': 'sync/trust/update/frozen must compile or authenticate unsupported source and reject without writes; pure uninstall-all is not a recompilation promise about immutable old code'},
    'acceptance_groups': [{'id': i, 'status': 'passed', 'files': files, 'tests': names, 'assertions': assertion} for i, files, names, assertion in groups],
    'failed_attempts_preserved': failed, 'runs': runs, 'required_final_runs': required,
    'runner': {'source': (PRIVATE / 'run.py').read_text(), 'sha256': sha((PRIVATE / 'run.py').read_bytes()), 'cache_origin': 'existing temporary A6 three caches; tests use -count=1, GOPROXY=off, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly, GOWORK=off', 'external_variables_removed': ['CODEX_HOME', 'CODEX_SANDBOX', 'STYLE_HOME', 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR', 'CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG_DIR', 'CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL', 'CLAUDE_EFFORT', 'PLUGIN_ROOT', 'STYLE_PERF', 'STYLE_PERF_OUTPUT', 'STYLE_M3_A6_RECORD', 'STYLE_UPDATE_GOLDENS', 'STYLE_REFRESH_HELPER', 'STYLE_REFRESH_TURN', 'STYLE_REFRESH_WORKER']},
    'source_sha256': source,
    'not_run': ['real Codex or Claude harness/model delivery (B3/C5 pending)', 'Claude cloud or plugin (deferred)', 'Linux or Windows native execution', 'remote CI', 'official API counting (both remain 0/40)', 'D5 or later implementation'],
    'report_builder': {'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), 'reproduction': 'Extract this source and recorded runner to the private directory, rerun listed commands from the repository using the final source/binary hashes, then build this report. Historical logs are private temporary evidence; deterministic fixtures and commands remain in repository.'}
}
REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'new_functions': len(functions), 'leaf_cases': len(leaves), 'new_pass_events': len(passes), 'full_pass_events': 3445, 'failed_runs_preserved': len(failed), 'binary_sha256': cli['binary_sha256']}, ensure_ascii=False))
